WelcomeTitle: Plan trips together, at your own pace
WelcomeBody: Jourfold keeps every trip as an open folder on your computer. Try ideas as variants, record versions, and share when you are ready.
WelcomeStep1Body: Drag across the timetable to add activities, or collect ideas in the Inbox first.
WelcomeStep2Body: Variants let you compare a cheaper or slower plan without losing the original.
WelcomeStep3Body: Publish privately to GitHub or your own Git server. It works offline too.
SampleCreated: Sample trip created. Feel free to change or delete it.
NewTripSubtitle: Only the title is needed. You can change everything later.
DatesHint: Leave the dates empty if they are not fixed yet. Jourfold also derives dates from the plan.
YourNameHint: Adds you as a traveller and signs your versions. Stored only in this trip and on this computer.
SavedAtHint: The trip is an ordinary folder with readable files and full version history.

NoBookingsBody: Keep confirmation numbers, prices and documents together with the plan.
CostsHint: Amounts stay in their own currency. Nothing is converted automatically.
NoCostsBody: Track what you spent and set a budget per currency.
NoAutoConversion: Totals are per currency. Jourfold never rewrites amounts with current exchange rates.
TasksHint: Things to do before and during the trip

NoPlacesBody: Places appear on the map and connect activities, stays and transport.
CollectionsHint: Group places and ideas, like restaurants to try
NoCollectionsBody: Collect beaches, museums or maybes without scheduling them.
StreetMapBody: Map images come from OpenStreetMap. Only the map area you look at is sent to their server; your trip stays on this computer. You can change this in Settings.
MapEmptyTitle: No places on the map yet
MapEmptyBody: Add coordinates to a place, or turn on online maps to search addresses.
MapEmptyBodyOnline: Add a place and search its address to see it here.

VersionMessageHint: Suggested from your changes. Edit it freely.
NothingToVersion: Everything is already in a version.
HistoryHint: Every version of this trip, newest first. You can restore any of them.

Restored: Version restored. Create a version to keep it.
AlreadyThisVersion: The plan already matches this version.
UnversionedChanges: Changes not in a version yet

UnversionedChangesBody: This needs your latest edits recorded as a version first. Jourfold can create it with a suggested description.

ArchiveCurrent: Switch to another variant before archiving this one.

PrivateByDefault: Private: only people you invite can see it.

ProvidersHint: Connect accounts to publish and find trips. Generic Git over HTTPS and SSH works without an account here.

AboutJourfoldLicense: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
AboutTravelRepo: Jourfold keeps every trip in the open TravelRepo format. Other programs can read and write the same folders.
AboutPluginsEmpty: No plugins loaded. Plugins can be added in Settings under Plugins.
OpenSourceComponentsHint: Jourfold is built with Avalonia, SkiaSharp, Noda Time, Lucide icons and other open-source software.
GitHubAccountHint: Publish trips to your account, invite people and find trips shared with you.
DisconnectGitHubBody: Jourfold forgets the sign-in for @{0} on this computer. Trips you already shared stay on GitHub and keep syncing once you connect again. To remove Jourfold's access completely, revoke it in your GitHub settings under Applications.
PublishToGitHubAs: Creates a private repository in the account @{0}.
KeepLocalHint: You can publish or invite people later with Share.
UnexpectedError: Something went wrong. That action was stopped; Jourfold keeps running.
UnexpectedErrorBody: Jourfold stopped an action because of an error in the app. Saved trips are not affected. The details are also written to {0}. You can copy them into a bug report.
ArrivalBeforeDeparture: The arrival is before the departure. Check the dates, times and timezones.
CoordinatesNeedBoth: Enter both latitude and longitude. The place is saved once both are filled in.
LatitudeRange: Latitude is a number between -90 and 90, for example -37.0093.
LongitudeRange: Longitude is a number between -180 and 180, for example 174.7841.
CoordinatesPasteHint: Tip: paste coordinates such as -37.0093, 174.7841 from a map into either empty field.
